item.title: News
item.description:
• [Aug 2026] Launched Relatos y Ciencia, my Spanish-language podcast exploring the stories behind science and discovery.
  • [Jun 2026] Appointed General Chair of the ⁠Women in Computer Vision (WiCV) Workshop at CVPR 2026, held in Denver, USA.
  • [May 2026] Our paper in Multimodal Safety was accepted to ACL 2026, San Diego, USA.
  • [Mar 2026] Our paper CURE was accepted for an Oral presentation at CVPR 2026, Denver, USA.
  • [Feb 2026] Co-organized the ⁠KAUST Rising Stars in AI Symposium 2026 at KAUST, Saudi Arabia.
  • [Jun 2025] Co-organized the ⁠Women in Computer Vision (WiCV) Workshop at CVPR 2025, held in Nashville, USA.
  • [Apr 2025] Invited as a keynote speaker at the 2025 Innovation Week hosted by Fundación Santa Fe de Bogotá, Colombia.
  • [Apr 2025] Co-organized the ⁠KAUST Rising Stars in AI Symposium 2025 at KAUST, Saudi Arabia.
